name: woku
description: Voice-of-customer for OpenAI Codex. Design a listening program, run the VoC instruments (NPS, CSAT, CES, wokus), and turn every signal into a support ticket or an action plan, through woku's MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Turn customer feedback into tickets and action plans.
interface.longDescription: Connect your agent to woku, the voice-of-customer platform. Design a listening program for your customer journey, place the fast VoC instruments (NPS, CSAT, CES, wokus) at each moment of truth, and turn every signal into a support ticket or an action plan.
defaultPrompt: How do I start listening to my customers?
Design a VoC program for my customer journey
